gist: Bhrigu, a proud Brahmin, comes to Vishnu's abode and is annoyed that Vishnu does not come to welcome him.
Anecdote about celebrities at a recent Ambani wedding serving guests; he hedges he only heard it.
Notes the host did not ask Sadhguru or Ramdev to serve plates or dance, while film stars were made to dance.

hindi: ज्ञान क्या नतमस्तक है बड़े से बड़ा व्यक्ति धनवान भी ज्ञान को पैर पकड़ता है
says: Knowledge commands bowing: even the richest and most powerful person touches the feet of knowledge. So in his scheme the Jupiter side (knowledge) ranks above the Venus side (wealth, glamour).
cells_derived_method: none: a general ranking of knowledge over wealth, not tied to a house or sign. Derived: a strong Jupiter in a kendra or the 9th would show respect from the wealthy.

Derived: exalted Jupiter in the 10th in Cancer gives public standing built on knowledge.

classical_check: Agrees in spirit with Jupiter as guru and Brahmin karaka; no classical rule states this ranking.

gist: Bhrigu enters Vishnu's chamber, Lakshmi signals he is asleep, Bhrigu says the all-knowing Vishnu is faking and kicks him on the chest.
Vishnu rises, holds Bhrigu's foot and asks if he was hurt; Bhrigu replies that he knows Vishnu was pretending, Vishnu calls it his divine play.

hindi: लक्ष्मी जी शुक्र मैं तो नहीं मुझे तो गुस्सा रहा मेरे दिल पर चोट लग गई ... दिल तो पागल है जी एक सेकंड में टूटता है
says: Lakshmi, as Venus, is hurt in her heart by the kick; he says the heart breaks in a single second. Venus is thus the planet of the heart, easily wounded and quick to curse in anger.
cells_derived_method: none: a nature statement for Venus. Derived: Venus afflicted by Mars, Saturn, Rahu or the 6th, 8th or 12th lord shows heart breaks; effect area follows the house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in Libra in the 5th with a malefic aspect shows heartbreak in romance.
Derived: exalted Venus in the 12th is deeply feeling but may hide hurt or lose through bed pleasures.

classical_check: Venus as significator of love and emotion agrees; he says nothing about a specific rule.

gist: Lakshmi curses that she will never come to a Brahmin's house; he scolds the pandits that they will stay poor unless they have Jupiter-form knowledge.

hindi: शुक्र जो कन्वर्शन का देवता है उसकी एक बड़ी कमाल की फैसिलिटी होती है जब वो उच्च का होता है ना तो फुल अयाशी करता है
says: Venus is the god of conversion; when exalted (in Pisces) it does full indulgence. So an exalted Venus pushes pleasure-seeking to the limit.
cells_derived_method: Venus in Pisces in each house channels indulgence into that house's topic, with Pisces' watery, dissolving, spiritual nature: 2nd money and food, 5th romance, 7th partners, 12th beds and foreign pleasure.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aquarius; indulgence in food, wealth display and speech, with Venus ruling 4 and 9 so comforts and luck feed it.
Derived: lagna Scorpio; romance and entertainment indulgence, with Venus ruling 7 and 12 so partners and bed pleasure join in.
Derived: lagna Aries; Venus rules 2 and 7 and sits in the 12th, giving bed pleasure and spending abroad.

ambiguity: 'Conversion' may mean transformation or a Hindi use of 'convert' for change of energy; 'full indulgence' is his word 'अयाशी' and may be judgemental, not a classical result.
classical_check: Classical texts call exalted Venus strongly beneficial (comforts, wealth), with indulgence a side effect; they do not call it a fault by itself.

hindi: किसी का उच्च का शुक्र सातवें घर पत्नी के घर में हो तो उसका तलाक हो जाता है ... बेस्ट पोजीशन यस ये अजीबोगरीब बातें है ज्योतिष की
says: Exalted Venus in the 7th house, the wife's house, gives divorce. He calls it the best position yet it gives a bad result, a strange fact of astrology. It is stated as certain, so a tradition claim.
cells_derived_method: Only one cell is stated: Venus in Pisces in the 7th (lagna Virgo). Derived: Venus exalted in other houses affects that house's matters, not the marriage; Venus in the 7th in other signs, for example own Libra or Taurus, is not covered by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in own Libra in the 7th (Malavya yoga) shows a strong partner bond; his divorce claim is not about this cell.
Derived: exalted Venus in the 2nd gives wealth and family comforts, not a divorce rule.

ambiguity: Numbers are house numbers here. D9 7th house exaltation may also count, not said. Divorce is stated as certain; treat as a tradition claim to test.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts say exalted Venus in the 7th is strong for marriage, though Venus in Pisces for lagna Virgo is also the 2nd-lord debilitation-side mix; many practitioners note delays or sensuality, not certain divorce.

gist: Bhrigu forgives Vishnu but, as Lakshmi has cursed, he curses her to be born on earth and says Vishnu's insult will bring him the same fate.
Lakshmi trembles in regret at what she said in anger; Vishnu says the curse is a blessing to him.
The footprint on the chest seen on Krishna idols is Bhrigu's footmark, shown on many Laddu Gopal statues.
Some idols show the footprint and some do not; Vishnu asks Bhrigu what he will do now that Lakshmi will not obey the curse.
Bhrigu says he will write a text so that wealth (Lakshmi) will come to the feet and need not even be earned; Vishnu agrees.

Short story: in later births Lakshmi became wife of Rama and Krishna; Krishna's 16108 wives are said to include eight forms of Lakshmi, who is always Vishnu's wife; then Bhrigu wrote his text, cut off.

hindi: भृगु संगीता के अंदर तीन जन्मों का लेखा जोखा आता है ... अरुण संगिता भी है ऐसे रावण संगीता भी है काली किताब लाल किताब

hindi: भृगु संगीता के अंतर्गत ... आपके इतने बच्चे होंगे इतना भाई होगा यह समस्या ... यह उपाय करो ... नया निकलेगा
says: He says a Bhrigu Samhita reading states counts of children and siblings, the problems tied to named persons, and a remedy, but a later reading can come out different because in between a new Jupiter-type person (a guru or new associate) entered your life and changed the timeline.

hindi: जो पता चलेगा वह आज की टाइमलाइन में फिर सच होगा हो सकता कल फिर गलत हो जाए लेकिन अगर आप परिवर्तन नहीं करा पाए तो वही चलेगा 10 साल बाद भी

hindi: भृगु पुत्र है शुक्र ... बृहस्पति की ही कृपा से आप ज्ञान ले सकते हैं तो आपको कुंडली में बृहस्पति सेट कैसे करना है अपना वरुण घर में कैसे सेट करना है

It is each person's own destiny; keep a doctor and an astrologer as friends, as you keep a dog at home, and give him some respect.
Brahmins are quick to anger and kick the chest; elephant and Brahmin are nobody's companions; each says he alone knows.
The real Brahmin is one who knows Brahman; one who says you are right and I am wrong is a sign you found a guru.

ambiguity: The sentence is cut at the end of the caption; Rahu is not mentioned yet.
classical_check: Agrees: eclipses happen at the nodes (Rahu and Ketu).

hindi: जब चांद के ऊपर सूरज की रोशनी गिरनी बंद हो गई तो चंदा का एक्लिप्स लग गया तो एक पोजीशन हो गई राहु की और एक पोजीशन हो गई केतु की
says: He explains an eclipse physically: when sunlight stops falling on the Moon, the Moon is eclipsed, and the two eclipse positions are what are called Rahu and Ketu.
cells_derived_method: none: this is an astronomical explanation, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: He says Moon eclipse first, then Rahu and Ketu as the two positions; which node goes with which luminary is only fixed in the next lines.
classical_check: Agrees with the standard view that Rahu and Ketu are the lunar nodes where eclipses occur.

hindi: राहु केतु को ग्रह नहीं होते छाया ग्रह इनकी छाया पड़ने के कारण से छाया पड़ना मीन सूरज की किरणें चंदा को नहीं मिल रही
says: Rahu and Ketu are not real planets but shadow planets; their shadow falling is what blocks the Sun's rays from reaching the Moon.
cells_derived_method: none: a nature statement about the nodes; in any cell they act through the sign lord they sit with and the house they occupy.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a shadow body in the 7th in Gemini would act like Mercury (sign lord) in partnership matters, rather than as its own substance.
Derived: a node in the 10th in Scorpio takes the nature of Mars-Uranus lordship and shows in career as intensity without a body of its own.

ambiguity: Calling them shadow planets conflicts with his later use of them as full lords of signs (he gives Ketu and Rahu signs).
classical_check: Agrees: classical texts call them chhaya grahas; they get no sign of their own in the main texts, which he later contradicts.

hindi: जब चांद बीच में आ गया धरती के और सूरज के तो किरण अटक गई तो हमें लग रहा सूरज गायब हो गया काला हो गया तो सोलर एक्लिप्स है
says: A solar eclipse is when the Moon comes between Earth and Sun, blocking the rays, so the Sun seems to vanish and turn black.
cells_derived_method: none: astronomy, not house or sign dependent.
classical_check: Agrees with astronomy; classical texts add the Rahu myth on top.

hindi: जब चांद चला गया तो सूरज की किरण को वापस फेंकता है चांद तो दिखता है चांद नहीं तो चांद नहीं दिखता वह अंधेरा हो गया अंधकार
says: The Moon is only visible because it throws back sunlight; with no sunlight reaching it, the Moon goes dark and cannot be seen.
cells_derived_method: none: Moon as a reflector of the Sun is a general principle; strength by Moon-Sun distance (phase) matters in every cell equally.
ambiguity: The caption blends the lunar eclipse explanation with phase; the intended point is Moon shines by Sun's light.
classical_check: Agrees: classical Moon strength depends on Sun-Moon elongation (paksha bala).

hindi: एक पोजीशन को राहु कहते हैं एक को केतु कहते हैं तो राहु ने क्या किया सूरज को खा लिया केतु ने क्या किया चंदा मामा को खा लिया ग्रहण लगा दिए
says: One eclipse position is called Rahu and the other Ketu; in the story Rahu swallows the Sun and Ketu swallows the Moon, causing eclipses.
cells_derived_method: none: mythic role assignment, Rahu as Sun-eater and Ketu as Moon-eater; in a chart this points to Rahu afflicting Sun-matters (father, authority) and Ketu afflicting Moon-matters (mind, mother) when conjunct.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu with the Sun in Leo in the 1st would be the Sun-eater setup at the self house, shaking identity and authority.
Derived: Ketu with the Moon in Cancer in the 4th would be the Moon-eater setup at the home and mother house, giving inner detachment.

ambiguity: Rahu is said to eat the Sun and Ketu the Moon, which is not the usual story (Rahu is usually the head that swallows both); he fixes his own convention here.
classical_check: Differs: classical myth has Rahu's head swallow both luminaries; assigning Ketu to the Moon is his teaching convention.

hindi: सूरज को खाने वाला कौन है राहु उसके पास होना चाहिए यहां तो आपके बुध के साथ हो गया राहु
says: The eater of the Sun is Rahu, so Rahu should be near the Sun; in his example chart Rahu has ended up next to Mercury, which is put in the sign by the Sun.
cells_derived_method: Rahu conjunct Sun gives the eclipse-type affliction in whichever house they share; here he moves Rahu to Mercury's side to introduce Rahu's own sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, Rahu with Mercury in Virgo in the 6th: Rahu in a Mercury sign, energy in service, debt and rivals; not said by him.
Derived: lagna Libra, Rahu in Virgo in the 12th: foreign, expense and isolation themes through a Mercury-flavoured Rahu; not said by him.

ambiguity: Caption is garbled and joins two sentences; the move of Rahu next to Mercury is a teaching step, not a rule.
classical_check: Silent on Rahu moved to Mercury's side; Virgo as Rahu's sign is a minority view (some texts give Rahu Virgo or Aquarius).

hindi: ये चार नंबर की राशि किसकी हो गई अब राहु की यह हमारे को राहु की राशि मिल गई है और 12 नंबर की राशि किसकी मिलेगी अब केतु की
says: He gives Rahu a sign of its own (placed with Mercury, so effectively Virgo) and Ketu the sign number 12, Pisces, so every node has a sign.
cells_derived_method: A node in its own sign gets the full strength of a sign lord; in each house it works out the house topics through that sign: Rahu in Virgo in house N or Ketu in Pisces in house N, house N matters done in a detached or magnified way.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Virgo in the 6th, lagna Aries: strong Rahu, wins over enemies and debts through unusual means.
Derived: Ketu in Pisces in the 12th, lagna Aries: own-sign Ketu, moksha, withdrawal, sleep and foreign leaning.
Derived: Ketu in Pisces in the 7th, lagna Virgo: detached partner matters; Pisces here is Venus's exaltation sign, so a conflict of nature.

ambiguity: Caption says 'number 4' for Rahu's sign, which cannot be Cancer (that is the Moon's in the same breath); he is placing Rahu with Mercury so it is Virgo (6). 12 = Pisces is clear.
classical_check: Differs from the standard scheme where Rahu and Ketu have no own sign; some texts give Rahu Aquarius or Virgo and Ketu Scorpio or Pisces.

hindi: यह मंगल की है शुक्र की है बुध की है चंदा मामा की है सूरज की है राहु की है
says: He recaps the lordship order of the first six signs in his 12-planet scheme: Aries Mars, Taurus Venus, Gemini Mercury, Cancer Moon, Leo Sun and then Rahu's sign.
cells_derived_method: Each planet in its own sign is strong in all 12 houses; the house gives the area. Standard sign lords are used for these six.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Cancer in the 10th (lagna Libra): own-sign Moon in the career house, public dealing and nurture-type work.
Derived: Sun in Leo in the 5th (lagna Aries): own-sign Sun in the children and intelligence house, strong authority and creative status.
Derived: Venus in Taurus in the 2nd (lagna Aries): own-sign Venus in the wealth and speech house, sweet speech and money from arts.

ambiguity: Rahu's sign number is garbled in the captions; here treated as Virgo (6) in sequence.
classical_check: Agrees for the first five signs (standard); Virgo to Rahu is his extension.

hindi: राहु के बाद शुक्र आ गया दो नंबर के साथ सात थाय सात नंबर यह नेप्चून की है
says: After Rahu comes Venus again, sharing the 2nd-sign number with the 7th: Libra (7) is given to Venus together with Neptune, so Libra belongs to Neptune in his extra-planet scheme.
cells_derived_method: Libra gets a second lord, Neptune, besides Venus; in each house a planet in Libra gives that house's matter a Venus plus Neptune flavour (relationship, idealism, blur).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: planet in Libra in the 7th (lagna Aries): marriage house with both Venus and Neptune lords, ideal or confused partner image.
Derived: planet in Libra in the 12th (lagna Scorpio): bed pleasures, foreign, spiritual escape coloured by Neptune.

ambiguity: '2 with 7' means Taurus (2) and Libra (7), both Venus signs, with Libra also given to Neptune.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts have no outer planets; Venus alone rules Libra.

hindi: फिर आठ नंबर आ गया यह यूरेनस की है नेप्चून वरुण देवता है यह इंद्र या अरुण देवता है अलग अलग कई जगह मतभेद है सब चलता है
says: Scorpio (8) goes to Uranus, whom he equates to Indra or Aruna; Neptune is Varuna; he accepts that sources differ on these god names and says just use the common ones.
cells_derived_method: Scorpio gets a second lord Uranus besides Mars; a planet in Scorpio in each house shows Mars intensity plus sudden Uranus change in that house's topic.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: planet in Scorpio in the 8th (lagna Aries): own-sign depth with Mars and Uranus, sudden gains or shocks, research.
Derived: planet in Scorpio in the 3rd (lagna Virgo): bold, unconventional communication and effort.

ambiguity: Names of the outer planets are from Hindu gods in varying traditions (Varuna, Indra, Aruna, Brahma, Prajapati); his mapping is a convention.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts give Scorpio to Mars only; outer planets are modern additions.

hindi: यह केतु की हो गई 10 के साथ 11 नंबर था ये प्लूटो की हो गई
says: The next signs are assigned: a Ketu sign is mentioned, and number 11, Aquarius, is given to Pluto alongside Saturn (10 and 11 being Saturn's two signs).
cells_derived_method: Aquarius gets Pluto as second lord with Saturn; a planet in Aquarius in a house gives that house's matter Saturn discipline with Pluto upheaval and rebirth.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: planet in Aquarius in the 11th (lagna Aries): own gain house, big networks, long-run gains with sudden transformations.
Derived: planet in Aquarius in the 8th (lagna Cancer): hidden matters, longevity topics, deep restructuring through Pluto.

ambiguity: The mention of Ketu here conflicts with Ketu already getting sign 12; probably a caption mix-up. Pluto to Aquarius (11) is the readable part.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts have Saturn only for Aquarius.

hindi: सात आठ सारे आ गए तो 12 ग्रह हो गए 12 राशियां हो गई यानी कि आपको जिस राशि को देखना है उसका मालिक कौन है यह देखना और उस मालिक की राशि कहां पड़ी है
says: With all of them assigned there are 12 planets for 12 signs: to read any sign, find its lord, then see where that lord's own sign falls in the chart.
cells_derived_method: Method: for each house, take the sign on it, find that sign's lord among the 12, then locate the lord's placement (house and sign); the result depends on both house and sign of the lord.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: planet in Gemini in the 3rd: its lord Mercury and Mercury's placement in say the 11th would tie courage and effort to gains.
Derived: planet in Sagittarius in the 9th: lord Jupiter's placement tells how fortune and dharma deliver.

ambiguity: 'Where the lord's sign lies' could mean its house position or the dispositor chain; default to the lord's placement.
classical_check: Agrees with the dispositor and lord-placement method of classical Jyotish, extended to 12 lords.

hindi: जो ग्रह जहां बैठा हुआ है अगर वो अपने घर के अंदर बैठा है या अपनी राशि को देख रहा है तो किंग भाई वो किंग है बिल्कुल राजा है
says: A planet sitting in its own sign, or aspecting its own sign, is a king: fully strong and in command.
cells_derived_method: Own-sign placement is strong in 12 houses and shows its power in that house's topic; aspecting own sign needs the planet's aspect target: Mars hits 4,7,8 from itself, Jupiter 5,7,9, Saturn 3,7,10.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Capricorn in the 4th (lagna Libra) is exalted, so the king reading comes from exaltation; its 4th, 7th and 8th aspects fall on Libra, Cancer and Gemini, not on Aries.
Derived: Mars in Libra in the 10th (lagna Capricorn) aspects Aries (own sign) by its 7th aspect; the 'king by seeing own sign' reading applies to career.
Derived: Saturn in Aries in the 7th (lagna Libra) aspects Capricorn by its 10th aspect, the own sign, so a 'king by sight' reading for partnership.

ambiguity: Whether aspecting own sign counts equal to sitting in it is his emphasis; classical texts treat own-sign aspect as a mild plus only.
classical_check: Own-sign strength agrees with classical texts; 'looking at own sign makes it a king' is stronger than the classical view.

hindi: अगर आपकी कुंडली में मंगल एक नंबर का है या एक नंबर से कस्प कर रहा है तो आपके नाभी केंद्र को जबरदस्त बल देता है हनुमान कॉन्शसनेस
says: Mars in sign number 1 (Aries) or near its border strongly empowers the navel centre; this is Hanuman consciousness.
cells_derived_method: Mars in Aries in each of 12 houses (lagna rotates Aries to Pisces): the navel-centre strength shows as drive in that house's topic; cusp cases at late Pisces or early Taurus.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Aries in the 1st, own sign in kendra (Ruchaka): body and self-drive strong.
Derived: Mars in Aries lagna Libra sits in the 10th: strong career action, work gets done through effort.
Derived: Mars in Aries with lagna Gemini is in the 12th: energy spent abroad, in isolation or on expense despite own-sign strength.

ambiguity: 'Number 1' could mean house 1 rather than sign 1; his own numbering in this series makes it the sign Aries. 'Cusp' reading needs multi-sign shares.
classical_check: Own-sign Mars is classically strong; Hanuman consciousness and the navel centre link are his teaching, not classical.

hindi: आपके थ्रू दुनिया के काम होते हैं आप दुनिया के काम निपटा लेते हो राम काज की तरह ही होता है कोई काम नहीं रुक सकता अगर आपके पास काम पहुंच गया
says: With strong Aries Mars, the world's work gets done through you; like Hanuman doing Ram's task, any work that reaches you cannot stop and gets finished.
cells_derived_method: The kind of work that reaches you follows the house Mars sits in: 3rd gives effort tasks, 6th gives conflict and service tasks, 11th gives gain and network tasks.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Aries lagna Sagittarius is in the 3rd: tasks of courage, media, siblings get finished through effort.
Derived: Mars in Aries lagna Gemini is in the 6th: disputes, debts and service tasks are cleared by you without stopping.
Derived: Mars in Aries lagna Sagittarius is in the 9th: dharma, father or guidance tasks reach you and complete.

ambiguity: A strong claim ('cannot stop') is promotional; read as high work-completion capacity.
classical_check: Silent; classically own-sign Mars gives energy and completion, but not this framing.

hindi: आपका कोई ऐसा मित्र है जो आपको हृदय जैसा प्यारा है तो मंगल है वो आपके जीवन के अंदर कोई है नहीं है मित्र जरूर होना चाहिए
says: A friend dear to you like your heart is Mars in your life; ask if there is such a friend, because one must be there.
cells_derived_method: Mars as the friend karaka; the friend's nature varies by house: 11th (Gemini lagna) social friends, 3rd close companions, 7th partner as friend.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Gemini in the 11th, lagna Leo: friends are a strong network and give gains.
Derived: Mars in Aquarius in the 3rd, lagna Sagittarius: a close friend as brother-like companion who acts with you.

ambiguity: The sentence uses Mars as the friend symbol; classically friends are 11th house and Mercury, Mars is the karaka of brothers.
classical_check: Differs: classical Mars is karaka of brothers and courage; friend karakas are the 11th house and Mercury or Venus.

hindi: कैसा मित्र वो नहीं जो घर बैठा है हनुमान को मित्र कहते थे राम और था वह भक्त तो जो मित्र तो घर बैठा रहता है आए दिन उसको तो अपने सीक्रेट बोल नहीं सकते वह तो पागल कर देगा खा जाएगा
says: The right friend is not a stay-at-home one; Ram called Hanuman a friend though he was a devotee; a friend who is always around cannot be told secrets and will drive you mad.
cells_derived_method: none: advice on how to choose a friend (guru-mitra); not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: Garbled caption: the friend not to choose is the one 'sitting at home' (a constant presence), the contrast being a friend who absorbs without gossip.
classical_check: Silent; this is his guidance, not a classical rule.

hindi: यह है अग्नि भस्म आपके प्रारब्ध के द्वारा बने हुए जितने भी पाप पुण्य कर्म है क्लेश है दुख है खत्म तो होंगे नहीं
says: Fire turns things to ash, but the sin, merit, pain and suffering already formed by your prarabdha will not simply end.
cells_derived_method: none: a karma principle; prarabdha is the whole chart, no single house or sign.
ambiguity: 'Agni bhasma' (fire and ash) ties to Mars as fire but the sentence is general.
classical_check: Agrees with classical prarabdha: fixed karma matures; remedies modify it rather than erase it.

hindi: 12 तो चेंज हो नहीं सकता वो तो बदलेगा नहीं तो क्या बदलेगा कि वो आए और जाए क्या करता है कोई इच्छा जोति या कोई गाइड या गुरु
says: The fixed core of karma cannot be changed, but its manner can: it may come and pass, through a wish, a guide or a guru.
cells_derived_method: none: general view on what remedies can alter; not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: '12' here is unclear: probably the fixed unchangeable part, not the 12th house. It could also be the 12th as the house of endings.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical view that remedies soften but do not delete destiny.

hindi: तलवार आई होती है मारने के लिए सुई बन जाती है निशान डाल के चली जाती है
says: A sword that came to strike turns into a needle and leaves only a mark before going; this is what a remedy does to a coming harm.
cells_derived_method: none: an image for remedy effect; no house or sign dependence.
classical_check: Silent; it is a teaching metaphor similar to the classical idea of a remedy reducing intensity.

hindi: हमारा उपाय क्या होता है करने के लिए भाई तेरे पैर पर चोट लगेगी हड्डी नहीं टूटेगी गारंटी है उपाय करा दिया बस यह उपाय हो जाता हड्डी टूट गई तो गए काम से
says: Example of a remedy's promise: a leg injury is coming, but with the remedy the bone will not break; if the bone breaks the remedy has not worked. A guarantee is claimed.
cells_derived_method: none: example of outcome softening; applies when a leg injury (a 12th or 6th type event) is indicated.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: an affliction on the 6th house could be a minor-injury indication, with remedy aimed at reducing severity; a tradition claim.

ambiguity: A 'guarantee' is his sales-style claim; flag as unmeasured. Injury prediction is a medical-type claim and not to be output as a diagnosis.
classical_check: Silent on guaranteed outcomes; classical remedies are described as reducing, not guaranteeing.

hindi: टांग कट गई तो तो गए टांग ना कटे हड्डी ना टूटे चोट लगे बच गए यह हो जाता है जितने अच्छे उपाय हो जाएंगे सिर्फ 12 पर रह जाएगा वो टांग पर चोट मारने आएगा
says: With better remedies the harm shrinks until only the final level remains: the injury lands on the leg as a bruise, with no amputation and no fracture.
cells_derived_method: none: describes diminishing severity with more remedies; not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: '12' is probably a level (final stage), the number is unclear in captions; could also mean the 12th house of loss. Not resolved.
classical_check: Silent; remedy levels are not defined classically.

hindi: ग्रह किसी हालत के अंदर ऐसा नहीं होगा कि आपकी टांग को उड़ा के ले गया क्योंकि टांग जो है वह चिजी है
says: A planet will never in any situation blow your leg away, because the leg is a physical thing; the planetary force is energy, not matter.
cells_derived_method: none: a general claim that planets act as energy, not as physical force.
ambiguity: 'Chizi' is likely 'cheez' (a thing, matter). The sentence spans the next timestamp.
classical_check: Differs from classical texts that predict injury, loss of limb or accident through planets.

hindi: ऊर्जा जो है वह 12 पर है एनर्जी इक्वल टू एमसी स्क्वा जब तक आप उसको चिजी नहीं दोगे एनर्जी आपके टांग को काटेगी नहीं
says: Using E=mc², he says energy stays at its own level and cannot cut your leg until you give it matter to act on.
cells_derived_method: none: a physics analogy; no house or sign dependence.
ambiguity: '12' again unclear (level, or the 12th house); the E=mc² analogy is a teaching device.
classical_check: Silent; not a classical doctrine.

hindi: 12 पर बहुत सुंदर प्रश्न है 12 पर खत्म कर दिया आगे ना बने 12 पर या खत्म कर दिया के लिए बुद्ध की नीति अपनानी पड़ेगी कोई रिएक्शन मत दो
says: To end the karma at that level so it does not carry forward, he says you must follow the Buddha's way: give no reaction at all.
cells_derived_method: none: a behaviour remedy; no house or sign dependence.
ambiguity: He answers a question from the audience; the '12' reference stays unclear.
classical_check: Silent; no reaction as a karma remedy is a Buddhist teaching, not a classical Jyotish remedy.

hindi: हम क्या करते हैं दो नए कर्म कर देते हैं चार गाली और भग देते हैं अब उसके लिए नया ऐड कर लिया कर्म हो गया
says: What we normally do is react by abusing someone back, which adds fresh karma on top of the old; so reacting is how karma keeps growing.
cells_derived_method: none: karma mechanics; no house or sign dependence.
classical_check: Silent; matches the general kriyamana karma idea.

hindi: जिसने कर्म समाप्त करने हैं वो रिएक्शन ना दे हम बिना रिएक्शन एक और जी ही नहीं सकते मर भी नहीं सकते
says: Whoever wants to finish karma must not react; yet he admits we cannot live, or even die, without reacting, so it is very hard.
cells_derived_method: none: behaviour principle.
ambiguity: The caption 'ek aur' is garbled; the meaning is the difficulty of no-reaction living.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: मंगल एक नंबर राशि का मंगल कोल रख लिया एंप्लॉई रख लिया एंप्लॉई मित्रवत होगा आपके हनुमान कॉन्शसनेस ऑन रहेगी आपके काम नहीं रुकेंगे
says: With Mars in sign 1 you effectively keep a friendly employee or helper; Hanuman consciousness stays switched on and your tasks do not stop.
cells_derived_method: The helper is the house topic where Mars sits: 6th gives service staff, 3rd gives helpers and siblings, 10th gives subordinates at work.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Aries in the 6th: obedient staff and helpers; service and competition handled through them.
Derived: Mars in Aries in the 10th: loyal subordinates in career who finish tasks.
