hindi: सूरज हम यहीं से खाते हैं यहीं अमृत चक्र है यह हमारी खोपड़ी भी कहती है यहां से एक ड्रॉप गिरता है नीचे जाता है
says: We take in the Sun from this point, which is the amrit chakra; a drop falls from the skull here and travels down. He claims the nectar drop from the head is the route by which the Sun's energy feeds the body.
cells_derived_method: none: yoga-anatomy statement, no house or sign dependence.
ambiguity: Whether the amrit chakra here is the bindu or the crown is not said.
classical_check: Silent in Jyotish; comes from yoga and tantra.

gist: Says he discussed this in the Dreams part two class, and that it is what is needed for Varuna's grace.

hindi: अपने घर के अंदर हमने देवता का स्थान बनाना ही बनाना है अब कैसा बनना है मंदिर तो भाई पिताजी चाचाजी ताऊ जी हमारे नॉर्थ ईस्ट में बनाते
says: Every home must have a place for a deity, and the question is what form it takes; elders usually build the temple in the north-east. He is setting up to question that common placement.
cells_derived_method: none: vastu placement, no house or sign split.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Agrees with the usual vastu rule that the north-east (Ishanya) is the prayer corner, which he then challenges.

hindi: वहां पर अदिति और दिति का कार्यक्रम शुरू हो जाता है आगे देवता है वो वो भी देवता है कोई देवता है कोई असुर
says: In that area the vastu mandala has Aditi and Diti, the mother of the devas and the mother of the asuras, so the neighbouring deities there are a mixture: some devas, some asuras. A prayer room placed blindly in that zone sits among both kinds.
cells_derived_method: none: vastu mandala claim.
ambiguity: Which zone exactly (north-east or west) is not clear from the caption.
classical_check: Aditi and Diti do occur in the vastu purusha mandala; the detail agrees with vastu shastra.

hindi: ऐसे मिलजुल के वास्तु बनता है ऐसे ही कुंडली के अंदर ... वहां पर कोई भगवान रखना आपको जो आपके सूटेबल हो सूटेबल कौन है यह कुंडली बताएगी
says: Vastu is a mixture of devas and asuras, and the kundli is built the same way; the deity to keep in that spot should be the one suited to you, and the chart tells which one. He links vastu to the chart as the way to choose the deity.
cells_derived_method: Which deity suits is read from the chart, typically 5th and 9th houses with their lords and the atmakaraka. That is derived and he does not state the rule here.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter lord of the 5th in own sign, a Vishnu-type or guru deity suits.
Derived: Sun as 9th lord, Surya or Ram form suits.

ambiguity: He promises to show the chart method later.
classical_check: Agrees that the ishta devata is read from the chart, classically via the 5th, 9th and atmakaraka in Navamsa.

hindi: हमारा देवता रखना है कौन सा जो जो वाला हमारी कुंडली का इष्ट है उस देवता को रखना है मंदिर बनाने को मना किया हुआ है
says: The deity to keep is the ishta of your own kundli; and for some, building a temple at home is forbidden by the chart. So the placement of the ishta deity is chart-dependent, and a full temple can be wrong for a native.
cells_derived_method: none: no planet, house or sign is given for when a temple is forbidden.
ambiguity: No condition is given for the 'forbidden' case.
classical_check: Silent on a temple ban; classical texts treat the home temple as universally fine.

hindi: हो सकता है आपकी कुंडली कहती है पूजा पाठ मत करो तो क्या करो बस देवता को रख दो वो रखा हुआ क्या करेगा वो सब कुछ कर देगा अपने आप
says: A chart may tell you not to do puja at all; then simply keep the deity in the house, and the placed deity will do everything by itself. Presence of the deity, without rituals, is enough for such natives.
cells_derived_method: none: no house or sign condition is given for a no-puja chart.
ambiguity: Which charts say no puja is not stated.
classical_check: Silent; no classical text prohibits puja by chart.

hindi: ऐसे ऐसे देवता है जिनके भोजन के सामान को घर में खास जगह रख दिया जाता है हम यही उपाय कराते हैं यहां पर ये रख दे वहां हल्दी की गांठ रख दे
says: Some deities are satisfied by keeping their food items at a special spot in the house; the remedies he gives are of this kind, for example put this item here, put a lump of turmeric there. The offering stands in for the deity.
cells_derived_method: none: item to spot mapping is not given. Turmeric is classically Jupiter's article, derived, not said.
ambiguity: Which item goes to which deity or spot is not named.
classical_check: Silent; turmeric as a Jupiter remedy is a common tradition.

hindi: पीला धागा बांध ले लाल बांध ले पता नहीं कैसे हो गए ये पता करने के ही अब हम क्लासेस कर रहे हैं कैसे होता है ये
says: Tying a yellow thread or a red thread works, and nobody knows how; these classes exist to find out how. He admits the remedies work without a known mechanism and frames the course as the search for the mechanism.
cells_derived_method: none: colours are not tied to a planet or house here. Yellow-Jupiter and red-Mars would be derived only.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Silent; thread remedies are folk tradition, not in classical texts.

hindi: इष्ट मतलब जो कनर है उसका इष्ट ... इष्ट मींस कुंडली के अंदर वरुण कौन होना चाहिए कुंडली किसी की भी
says: Ishta, for the person concerned or for any chart, means who the deity at the Varuna position in that kundli should be. So he defines ishta as the planet or deity filling the Neptune/Varuna slot of the chart.
cells_derived_method: none: how to pick the Varuna deity for each chart is promised later.
ambiguity: 'वरुण कौन' could mean which planet takes the Varuna role, not only which deity.
classical_check: Differs from classical ishta devata, which comes from the 5th house or atmakaraka in Navamsa.

gist: Jokes that he will take anyone's chart, even the audience's, and secrets will be exposed, so be afraid of him.

hindi: इसमें एक राशि होती है ये भाव फिक्स होते हैं 12 के 12 एक दो तीन ये फिक्स ही है यानी कि यहीं से शुरू होगी कुंडली वन
says: In the chart the houses (bhavas) are fixed, all 12 of them in positions 1, 2, 3 and so on, and the chart starts at the first house; the signs move around inside these fixed houses. So houses are the fixed frame and signs rotate through them.
cells_derived_method: Because signs rotate, each house gets each of the 12 signs for different births, which gives the 12 x 12 = 144 cells. Derived from the rotation he states.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries lagna, so house 2 is Taurus and house 10 is Capricorn.
Derived: Libra lagna, so house 2 is Scorpio and house 10 is Cancer.

ambiguity: Whole-sign houses are assumed; he does not say how cusps split a house.
classical_check: Agrees with the whole-sign house frame of the North Indian chart.

hindi: ये फोर ये सेवन ये 10 ठीक है जी ये 11 12 दो तीन ऐसे चलेगा ये फिक्स है राशि इसमें गोल-गोल घूम सकती है
says: He points out house positions 4, 7 and 10 on the chart (the angle houses) and then 11, 12, 2, 3 running around; the house positions never move while the signs can go round and round inside them. This repeats and confirms the fixed-house, moving-sign frame.
cells_derived_method: Houses 1, 4, 7 and 10 are the angles (kendras); the pairing of an angle with a sign changes with the lagna. Derived.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries lagna, Capricorn on the 10th, Saturn rules the angle of career.
Derived: Aries lagna, Cancer on the 4th, Moon rules the angle of home.

ambiguity: Pointing words ('यहां') are lost, positions are read in the usual North Indian layout.
classical_check: Agrees: the angles are 1, 4, 7, 10.

hindi: सूरज सुबह-सुबह यहां होते हैं ... 12:00 बजे सूरज यहां होगा शाम 6:00 बजे यहां होगा आधी रात को यहां होगा
says: The Sun moves through the fixed houses during the day, and the lagna at birth depends on the time: Sun on the ascendant at sunrise, then at the top at noon, then at the horizon at 6 pm, then at the bottom at midnight. The position of the Sun among houses therefore shows birth time.
cells_derived_method: Using the standard day cycle: Sun in house 1 at sunrise, 10 at noon, 7 at sunset, 4 at midnight. Derived from the classical clock, the caption does not give the house numbers.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: born at sunrise with Sun in Libra, the lagna is Libra and the Sun is in house 1.
Derived: born at noon with Sun in Aries means Aries is on the 10th, lagna Aries.
Derived: born at sunset with Sun in Aries, Aries is on the 7th, lagna Libra.
Derived: born at midnight with Sun in Leo, Leo is on the 4th, lagna Taurus.

ambiguity: The houses he points at are not in the caption; the timing positions are the standard ones.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical rule that Sun is in the 1st at sunrise, 10th at noon, 7th at sunset, 4th at midnight.

hindi: सूरज सुबह 6:00 बजे उग गया किसी ठंड के मौसम में तो उस समय का लगन ... तुला आता है आगे लिब्रा ... तो छ नंबर राशि हो जाएगी या सात नंबर
says: If someone is born at 6 am sunrise in a winter month, the lagna is the sign the Sun is in; in the season he means the Sun is in Virgo or Libra, so the rising sign would be sign 6 or sign 7. The birth at sunrise takes the Sun's own sign as the lagna.
cells_derived_method: Sunrise births take the Sun's sign as lagna across the year: Sun in Scorpio gives Scorpio lagna, Sun in Sagittarius gives Sagittarius lagna. Derived pattern, not said by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: sunrise birth in November, Sun in Scorpio in the 1st, strong vitality.
Derived: sunrise birth in January, Sun in Capricorn in the 1st, Sun in the sign of Saturn.

ambiguity: Caption is garbled; Virgo is Sun's month around September which is not exactly winter, and the sentence is cut at the end of the chunk.
classical_check: Agrees that at sunrise the Sun is in the ascendant sign.

hindi: एक राशि यहां पड़ेगी ... 10 और 11 का स्वभाव सेम चलेगा मान के चलो
says: Whatever house you look at, some sign will fall in it, and the house is not one sign only. He takes signs 10 and 11 (Capricorn and Aquarius) together and says they behave with the same nature, since both are Saturn signs.
cells_derived_method: Capricorn and Aquarius share Saturn as lord, so a house touched by either gets a Saturn flavour (discipline, delay, detachment). The house topic then decides where it shows. Capricorn is earthy and goal-driven, Aquarius is airy and group-driven, so the shared nature differs in style.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn-flavoured partnership, serious and late-bound marriage, duty over romance.
Derived: gains come slowly through networks and groups, detached friendships.
Derived: home life reserved and unconventional, emotional distance among family.

ambiguity: Caption says aapki rashi number 6 and then takes 10; likely he is picking an example sign, not stating a fixed fact. Numbers are sign numbers (Aries=1).
classical_check: Agrees: both signs are ruled by Saturn classically; his modern scheme may give Aquarius to Pluto as well.

hindi: य शनि की राशि है 10 नंबर अब शनि क्या कहता है मुन्ना पूजा पाठ नहीं करेंगे भाई एसल वर्ल्ड में रहूंगा मैं घर नहीं जाऊंगा
says: Sign 10 (Capricorn) is Saturn's sign. Saturn's attitude, which he voices in first person, is: no puja and rituals, I live in the material world and will not go home. So a Saturn-sign space or person is worldly and resists religious practice.
cells_derived_method: Saturn's worldly, anti-ritual temperament in Capricorn shows differently by house topic: in the 4th it hits home and domestic peace, in the 9th it hits dharma and father, in the 10th it turns into pure work orientation.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in Capricorn in the 4th (lagna Libra): little interest in home rituals, restless to be out working, strict household.
Derived: Saturn in Capricorn in the 9th (lagna Taurus): sceptical of religion and gurus, dharma through duty and work.
Derived: Saturn in Capricorn in the 10th (lagna Aries): career absorbs the person, little time for worship.

ambiguity: He speaks as Saturn's voice, so this is a character sketch, not a formal rule.
classical_check: Silent on puja habits specifically; Saturn as renunciate and worldly karaka is classical.

hindi: जो आपका लगन है अगर यहां 10 नंबर राशि है तो आपकी यहां पर दो नंबर राशि होनी चाहिए नेचुरली दो होगी आठ होगी
says: He is linking a sign sitting in one place of the chart (here the 10th sign) to the sign that must sit in the lagna, saying sign 2 will come naturally, and sign 8 also. The caption trails into a list, so the exact relation he wants is not clear.
cells_derived_method: Taurus and Scorpio are the 2nd and 8th signs. Capricorn is 5th and 9th from Taurus and 3rd from Scorpio, so lagna Taurus puts Capricorn in the 9th and lagna Scorpio puts it in the 3rd. This is my derivation and may not be his intent.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Taurus lagna puts Capricorn in the 9th, a trine.
Derived: Scorpio lagna puts Capricorn in the 3rd.

ambiguity: Garbled: could be the sign in the lagna, or sign-to-sign relation in his room-direction layout. The list 2, 8, 5, 11 continues in the next chunk and looks like the signs that fit with 10 in a layout. Not turned into a rule.
classical_check: Silent; no classical rule matches this wording.

hindi: ये दो नंबर राशि लगन में दिख रही है लेकिन हो सकता है काम एक नंबर कर रही है हो सकता है काम एक और दो कर रही है हो सकता है काम एक दो तीन कर रही है
says: A sign that appears in the lagna on the chart may in effect be working as the neighbouring sign. Sign 2 shown in lagna might act as sign 1, as 1 and 2 together, or as 1, 2 and 3. So a house is touched by two or three signs, and effects must be read on that spread.
cells_derived_method: Same logic for every house: the sign at the cusp mixes with the previous and next sign in proportion to degree. Early degrees lean on the previous sign, late degrees on the next. Each of the 144 cells has to be read with its neighbour signs weighted.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Taurus lagna at 2 degrees acts partly as Aries, so Mars-type drive on the self.
Derived: Taurus lagna at 28 degrees acts partly as Gemini, so Mercury-type talkative flavour on the self.
Derived: 7th house sign Scorpio with Libra mixing in gives a partner part-Venus, part-Mars.

ambiguity: None on meaning. It matches Rajat's multi-sign house rule.
classical_check: Agrees with the idea behind bhava chalit (house cusps vs sign boundaries); classical whole-sign reading does not do this.

hindi: जब 10 नंबर राशि यहां है तो यह खतरा है हो सकता है नौ नंबर भी काम कर रही है ... 10 11 कर रही है यह बड़ी खिचड़ी है इसमें आपको चलित कुंडली समझनी है निर भाव चलित और केपी
says: Same multi-sign warning applied to sign 10: when Capricorn is in a house, sign 9 (Sagittarius) may also be working there, or sign 11, or 10 and 11 together. He calls this a big khichdi and says you must understand chalit (bhava chalit, nirbhava chalit) and KP to resolve it.
cells_derived_method: Capricorn houses are blended with Sagittarius (Jupiter, dharma, optimism) and Aquarius (Saturn, networks). The planet in that house takes on the lord of whichever sign actually dominates by chalit or KP cusp.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 10th house with Sagittarius spill gives career with teaching, law or advisory colour; with Aquarius spill gives career in systems, technology or groups.
Derived: 2nd house (lagna Sagittarius) with Aquarius spill makes income come through networks and wealth is slower.
Derived: 6th house (lagna Leo) with Sagittarius spill softens enemies and debts into legal or advisory disputes.

ambiguity: He says nirbhava chalit, probably nirayana bhava chalit. Caption may have split the word.
classical_check: Agrees: bhava chalit is a classical correction for planets near cusps.

hindi: यहां पर 10 नंबर है तो वरुण देवता क्या कर रहा है आपको फिक्स करना है अगर यहां पर आपका 10 नंबर फिक्स हो गया तो 10 नंबर में मंगल उच्च का होता है
says: For a space or house whose sign is 10 (Capricorn), you first fix what Varuna (Neptune, his water deity) is doing there. Once sign 10 is fixed, remember Mars is exalted in sign 10, so Mars deity energy is strong in that spot.
cells_derived_method: Mars exalted in Capricorn gives its best output in each house by house topic: courage and career in 10th, property drive in 4th, effort-won gains in 11th, but Mars lordship by lagna also decides if it is a functional benefic.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: exalted Mars sitting in the 10th house (lagna Aries), a kendra with Ruchaka yoga.
Derived: exalted Mars in the 4th (lagna Libra), lord of 2 and 7, strong but heated home and property matters.
Derived: exalted Mars in the 8th (lagna Gemini), lord of 5 and 10 and a yogakaraka, hidden strength.

ambiguity: The Varuna part is unclear; he is speaking of fixing the Neptune deity placement in the room. The 10 here is a sign number, since Mars is exalted in sign 10.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars exalts in Capricorn. Neptune as a ruler is outside classical texts.

hindi: हनुमान जी की एक मूर्ति ले जा जाक पर्वत उठा रखा है ... पर्वत का फोटोग्राफ होना बहुत बढ़िया गजब है चित्रगुप्त फोटो खींच लेता है
says: A Hanuman image carrying the mountain suits the Mars-exalted placement. A photograph of a large mountain there is also very good, because a huge object is imprinted by Chitragupta (the subconscious record keeper) like a photo, so the mountain image gets stored in the subconscious.
cells_derived_method: Remedy is placed by sign nature, not by house. In a house where Mars is functionally benign it supports; where Mars is a malefic lord for the lagna it can stir conflict, as the next chunk shows for a quarrelsome home.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars image in the home-house could aggravate heat in family when Mars is lord of 2 and 7.
Derived: for Aries lagna the Mars image supports career and confidence.

ambiguity: He calls it a mountain photograph and says it is great, then qualifies it next chunk. The Chitragupta idea is his own, not classical Jyotish.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts give no Hanuman or mountain image rule; Mars as Hanuman karaka is a popular tradition.

gist: Aside that the Chitragupta class was already done earlier and the subconscious will take the photo.

hindi: यहां तो वरुण स्थापित है ... हनुमान जी के वहां पर पर्वत उठाए रखी हुई एक मूर्ति बस विश्राम कर रही है रखी है कोई टेंशन नहीं है घर में कलह रहती है
says: With Varuna already established in that spot, the Hanuman mountain-lifting idol only sits at rest and creates no tension. Yet in such a house quarrels continue, because the residents are not religious and do not accept the deity (Saturn type).
cells_derived_method: The deity helps only when the occupants' own chart supports the planet. Where Mars or Saturn is a functional malefic for the lagna, the idol gives no relief to quarrel.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Libra lagna household, Saturn is yogakaraka but Mars lords 2 and 7 (maraka), so a Mars idol adds little peace.
Derived: Cancer lagna household, Mars is yogakaraka so the same idol is helpful.

ambiguity: Run-on caption; the quarrel and non-believer remark may be about the Saturn-sign residents rather than the idol.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: सूर्य शनि साथ होता है बाप बेटे में दुश्मनी होती है क्लेश होता है कुंडली में दृष्टि होती है तो मारम मार होती है
says: When Sun and Saturn are together, father and son are enemies and there is strife. If there is an aspect between them in the chart, the clash becomes a heavy fight.
cells_derived_method: Sun-Saturn conjunction or aspect hurts the father relation and authority in the house topic where it falls. In the 9th or 10th it shows as father or boss conflict, in the 5th as trouble with children or mentors, in the 4th as home friction.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun debilitated with Saturn exalted in the 9th (lagna Aquarius): father and guru clash, dharma issues.
Derived: Sun with Saturn in own sign in the 10th (lagna Aries): career friction with authority.
Derived: Sun with Saturn in the 4th (lagna Scorpio): cold relations with parents at home.

ambiguity: None on planets. Strength of the clash is not defined.
classical_check: Agrees: Sun and Saturn are mutual enemies and the combination is classically bad for the father.

hindi: सूर्य पे शनि की दृष्टि है लेकिन सूर्य की शनि पे नहीं है तो बाप को बेटा मारता रहता बाप कुछ नहीं कर पाता
says: If Saturn aspects the Sun but the Sun does not aspect Saturn, the son keeps hitting the father and the father cannot do anything. The one-way aspect decides who dominates: Saturn is the son, Sun the father.
cells_derived_method: One-way aspect depends on the house gap: Saturn aspects 3rd, 7th and 10th from itself, the Sun only the 7th. So Saturn 3rd or 10th from the Sun gives one-way aspect on the Sun, Saturn is the dominating side.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in the 10th with Sun placed 3 houses before it in the 8th: Saturn hits Sun (Saturn aspects the 3rd from itself) one-way, a father-hurt pattern.
Derived: Saturn exalted in the 4th and Sun in the 6th, 10 houses apart: Saturn aspects the Sun by its 3rd aspect, Sun cannot return it.

ambiguity: Says that the full understanding of aspect will come later; so only the one-way idea is firm. He marks son as Saturn only by implication.
classical_check: Classical aspect rules (Saturn 3/7/10, Sun 7) agree with the one-way idea. Father-hits-father outcome is his colour, not classical.

hindi: तो बुध की रख दो बुद्ध भगवान बुद्ध हनुमान जी नहीं रखने घर में कलह रहती ऐसी काली सफेद पीला रंग बीच में आ जाए कोई बात नहीं शांत
says: Instead of Hanuman, place a Buddha statue (the Mercury deity, as he reads it) because quarrels continue with Hanuman in the home. Even if black, white or yellow colours come in, it is fine and stays peaceful.
cells_derived_method: Mercury calms Saturn-sign spaces because Mercury is Saturn's friend. Where Mercury is lord of a trine or kendra for the lagna it also helps; Mercury as 6th or 8th lord would be a weaker choice.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Taurus lagna household, Saturn rules 9 and 10 and Mercury rules 2 and 5, so a Mercury-type idol is well placed.
Derived: Sagittarius lagna household: Saturn rules 2 and 3 and Mercury rules 7 and 10, mixed benefit.

ambiguity: Budh (planet Mercury) and Buddha (the Buddha) are mixed up in the caption; he equates Buddha statue with Mercury energy.
classical_check: Silent: the Buddha idol for Mercury is not classical.

hindi: बुध 10 नंबर के अंदर पॉजिटिव है बुध देवता और बुध शनि का परम मित्र है शनि की राशि है
says: Mercury is positive in sign 10, a Saturn sign, because Mercury is Saturn's closest friend. So the Mercury deity brings peace in a Saturn-sign space. He says it is peace, not prosperity.
cells_derived_method: Mercury in Capricorn is a friendly-sign placement. Results by house topic: business and skill matters in 10th, learning in 5th, speech and income in 2nd; Mercury's own house lordships by lagna decide the quality.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in Capricorn in the 2nd (lagna Sagittarius), lord of 7 and 10, sober speech and steady income.
Derived: Mercury in the 6th (lagna Leo), lord of 1 and 4, handles service and debt practically.
Derived: Mercury in the 12th (lagna Aquarius), lord of 7 and 10, spending on partners or foreign work.

ambiguity: Positive means peace-giving for him, not exalted or strong. The caption is repetitive.
classical_check: Agrees: Mercury treats Saturn as a friend, and Capricorn is a friend's sign for Mercury.

gist: Repeats the words Mercury planet and Mercury deity several times, no new point.

hindi: चारों के इष्ट में एक का इष्ट अगर नेगेटिव है तो गड़बड़ हो गई
says: In a household of four, if the ishta (preferred deity) of even one member is negative for the chart of the space, there is trouble. Friend and enemy planets, which decide this, are promised for a later class.
cells_derived_method: For each member, the deity planet is judged by its friendship with the sign lord and by its house lordship in that member's own lagna. So the same idol can be good for one lagna and bad for another.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries-lagna member: Mars deity is lagna lord, helpful; Mercury-lord member (Virgo lagna) sees Saturn as 5th and 6th lord, mixed.
Derived: Virgo lagna member finds Saturn lord of 5 and 6, a Saturn deity can be mixed.

ambiguity: He defers the friendship rules to later; no specific list is given here.
classical_check: Silent; ishta devata is classically from the 5th house and Atmakaraka, not from the room's sign.

hindi: इसीलिए घर में मंदिर मत बनाओ ... अपने हृदय का देवता को रखो कॉमन चेक कराओ कि हम चार लोग है हमारा बेस्ट कौन है
says: So do not build a common temple at home. Keep the deity of your own heart, and do a common check among the four people of the house to find which deity is best for all. A deity negative for you will not work for you, even if it works for someone else.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: Whether he forbids any home temple, or only a mixed one of many deities, is not fully clear.
classical_check: Differs from common practice, which has a home puja space; classical texts silent.

hindi: यहां बृहस्पति की नेगेटिव दृष्टि होगी अगर यहां विष्णु रख दिए बंदे ने विष्णु रख दिए तो बर्बाद हो जाएगा इंसान क्योंकि वो एंटी है
says: If Jupiter has a negative aspect on this spot and the person places Vishnu there, the person will be ruined, because Vishnu (Jupiter's deity) is anti to the situation. He is warning against a deity that matches an afflicted planet. This is a strong claim and is tradition only.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter is negative when it is a 6th, 8th or 12th lord, or is debilitated or aspects a house that it harms. Houses touched by Capricorn (Jupiter debilitated) show this most.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the lagna (lagna Capricorn): Vishnu as a remedy gives less than expected.
Derived: Jupiter in Gemini in the 8th (lagna Scorpio is wrong here; Gemini is 8th for lagna Scorpio), where Jupiter is the lagna lord in a dusthana, so a Vishnu remedy is doubtful.
Derived: Jupiter debilitated in the 12th (lagna Aquarius), weak and the remedy loses power.

ambiguity: Negative aspect is not defined here, and which house Jupiter aspects is not stated.
classical_check: Silent: Jupiter-Vishnu link is traditional, the ruin claim is not classical.

hindi: विष्णु जी बुरा अच्छा नहीं करते विष्णु जी सिर्फ फेंकते हैं कि फल लो बेटा आपने चीनी रख ली ... आपको तो सूट नहीं करती
says: Vishnu does neither good nor bad, he only throws the fruit. What harms depends on whether it suits you: sugar can be fine for one and harmful for another, almonds are bad for someone with brittle bones. He flags no medical rule here, only the analogy that the same deity or substance suits one chart and not another.
cells_derived_method: Suitability is read per cell: a benefic planet is harmful where it is lord of 6, 8 or 12 for that lagna, so one remedy cannot be given to all.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in own sign in the 9th (lagna Aries), lord of 5 and 8, mostly helpful, with a hidden 8th-lord cost.
Derived: Jupiter in own sign in the 6th (lagna Libra), lord of 4 and 7, but in a dusthana so it gives less.

ambiguity: Bone and diet examples are only analogy, not a claim from a chart.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: remedies are judged by functional nature for the lagna.

gist: Analogy that God gives strength like water and the person may drown someone with it; God only gives, we choose.
Says God can protect or murder, a tongue can be sweet or a dagger, and karma is our free choice.

hindi: नौवे घर के देवता को वहां पर स्थापित कर लो आपकी सेटिंग होगी नौवे घर का देवता है कौन यह भी सीखना पड़ेगा
says: Install the deity of the 9th house in that place and your setting will work. Which deity belongs to the 9th house is still to be taught later in the course.
cells_derived_method: The 9th-house deity depends on the sign in the 9th of the person's own lagna, so it changes by lagna. This is derived by me and not said.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries lagna has Leo in the 9th, so a Sun-lord deity (Rama or Surya type).
Derived: Scorpio lagna has Pisces in the 9th, so a Jupiter-lord deity (Vishnu type).
Derived: Virgo lagna has Capricorn in the 9th, so a Saturn-lord deity.

ambiguity: He says 9th house, not 9th sign. In the multi-sign view, the deity may combine the 9th house signs.
classical_check: Classical texts tie the 9th to dharma, guru and ishta puja and support the idea in spirit.

gist: Ends the class and takes the last audience question.

hindi: अलमारी के बाहर लगा दो ना लोहे का लगाओ लोहे का देवता लगा दो लोहे की फोटोग्राफी लोहे के प्लेट ले लो उस पर फोटो लगा लो लोहा वहां की धातु है
says: For an almirah, put the deity picture on an iron plate and stick it outside with a magnet, because iron is the metal of that place. He is matching the object or spot's metal with the deity picture mount. Iron is Saturn's metal, which links it to the Capricorn thread.
cells_derived_method: Metal follows the planet of the sign of the spot: iron for Saturn signs, copper for Sun, silver for Moon. Only the Saturn sign case is shown here.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a Saturn-sign spot suits an iron mount for the picture.
Derived: Aquarius is also a Saturn sign, so iron fits there as well.

ambiguity: He says the metal of that place without naming Saturn. Iron to Saturn is my link, not a stated one.
classical_check: Agrees: iron is classically Saturn's metal.

gist: Audience joke about doing puja to marry in the next life and about guna milan.
Tells people to think good thoughts and jokes about having earned only abuse.

hindi: जिसको अपनी डेट ऑफ बर्थ नहीं पता ... इसकी भी कुंडली बन जाती है जिसकी डेट टाइम नहीं होती बन जाएगा
says: He says a chart can also be made for a person who does not know date of birth or time. He promises to explain how later, so no method is given here.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: Whether this means rectification, a prashna chart or his own system is not said.
classical_check: Agrees that methods exist: prashna and rectification are classical, but this method is not shown here.

gist: Audience member begins a manifestation question and asks about commands and words.
Question asks how to start a manifestation command, which words to use or avoid, with an example.

hindi: कमांड के अंदर नो नेगेटिव ना हो हाय हाय यह नहीं होना चाहिए क्योंकि जो बोल रहे हैं आप अक्षर अक्ष वैसा का वैसा ही अंतरिक्ष में जा रहा है
says: In a manifestation command, avoid no and negative words, and avoid cries like hay hay. The words you speak go into space exactly as said, so a sentence with negation sends the negative word.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: This is a speech and mantra practice, not a chart rule.
classical_check: Silent: classical Jyotish has no manifestation rule; the idea resembles mantra and sankalpa discipline.

hindi: एक अंतरिक्ष का देवता भी होता है एक होता है अनिल यह भी हमारे ईस्ट की बेल्ट में होता है साउथ ईस्ट साइड पर ... अग्नि देने वाला है देवता अनिल
says: Space (antariksha) has its own deity, Anil, who is in the south-east belt and gives fire to the whole sky. This is a vastu direction claim that a particular deity rules space and sits in the south-east.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: Caption mixes Anil, Agni and the south-east. The classical Vastu grid puts Anila in the north-west area and Agni in the south-east, so he may have swapped them or this is the caption.
classical_check: Differs: Vastu Purusha mandala puts Anila near Vayu in the west or north-west and Agni in the south-east.

hindi: अंतरिक्ष हमारे अंदर भी है हमारे नाभी के पास होता है ... नाभी से ही रेवरबरेट हो के ऊपर जा रहा है ... सीधा कॉस्मिक कनेक्शन है
says: Space also exists inside the body, near the navel. What you speak reverberates from the navel upward into the cosmos, so the navel is a direct cosmic connection point. This matches his earlier Mars-navel centre idea.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: He does not name Mars here; the link to the navel and Mars comes from his earlier pilot statement.
classical_check: Silent: the navel and space link is yogic (manipura or nabhi), not classical Jyotish.

hindi: नो होने का मतलब आप नाभी के नीचे जाकर मुन्ना को टच कर गए और वो भी तथास्तु हो
says: A no in the command means you have gone below the navel and touched the lower centre (he says munna, probably a slang or caption slip), and that gets granted too, as tathastu. So the negative wish is the one that is fulfilled.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: The word munna may be a garbled caption or a joke term for the lower body; the sentence ends mid-thought at the chunk edge.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: किसी भी कमांड में कुछ भी बोलो अब आप कह रहे हैं मुझे आईएस अफसर बनना है हां ठीक है गुड कमांड है फील करते हो फील विश्वास करते हो
says: A command given to the subconscious (his 'Munna') only works if you actually feel it and believe it; saying 'I want to be an IAS officer' is a fine command, but only if backed by felt belief.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: Munna means the subconscious mind in this series; the caption does not say so here, it is carried from earlier context.
classical_check: Silent; this is a mind-practice teaching, not a classical Jyotish rule.

gist: Joke about carrying an umbrella to God to ask for rain, to show faith without felt belief looks foolish.
Only one person becomes Mike Tyson or Usain Bolt; badminton example of hitting the shuttle too hard and losing, so skill of how to play matters.
Says he does not know how to feel the proper emotion for the command, DNA will reverberate, suggests watching the movie Lucy; then reads out the next audience question.
Audience question: should we think only positive or sometimes negative also; pencil versus razor, boat versus life jacket examples.

hindi: मुन्ना का खेल है तुम्हारी औकात ही नहीं है जब तक तुम इस चक्कर में लगे हो मैं ये सोचू मैं वो सोचूं ... तुम्हारा सोचने का काम नहीं है सोचने का डिपार्टमेंट सिर्फ मुन्ना के पास है
says: Choosing between positive and negative thinking is the wrong question, because thinking is not done by the conscious self at all; the subconscious (Munna) is the only department that thinks, and the conscious person only gives it direction.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: Captions are noisy around 'मामा' and 'धो देगा'; sense taken as the subconscious overrules the conscious attempt to control thoughts.
classical_check: Silent; consistent with the Moon/Manas-karaka idea in general but he does not link it to a planet here.

hindi: अंतरिक्ष में देखेंगे तो शनि के पास अभी मेरे ख्याल से 100 से ऊपर चांद निकाल लेंगे वो हमारा एक चांद है
says: Saturn is found to have over a hundred moons, against our one moon; he uses this to show how vast the planetary scale is compared with the human mind.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: Moon count is an astronomy remark, approximate ('in my opinion over 100'); carries no astrological rule.
classical_check: Silent; classical Jyotish does not count satellites.

hindi: जुपिटर के पास 84 ढूंढे गए अभी नेपच्यून यूरेनस प्लूटो सोचो 12 साल में ... बृहस्पति गोल घूमते हैं एक बार शनि 30 साल में
says: Jupiter has about 84 moons found so far; orbit lengths grow outward: Jupiter circles the zodiac once in 12 years and Saturn in 30 years.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter takes about a year per sign and Saturn about 2.5 years per sign, so each transits a given house of a lagna for that length; this is derived arithmetic, not said by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn exalted in Libra in the 7th (lagna Aries) stays about 2.5 years, a long partnership-testing window.
Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 1st takes about a year to move on, so the lagna-strength period is short.

ambiguity: Moon counts are astronomy trivia; the useful content is the orbital periods.
classical_check: Agrees: classical sidereal periods are about 12 years (Jupiter) and 29.5 years (Saturn).

hindi: यूरेनस 84 साल में एक और अयो बड़ी अब नेप्चून 164 साल में ... प्लूटो 200 264
says: The outer planets take far longer: Uranus about 84 years, Neptune about 164 years, Pluto about 248 years (caption says 264, likely a speech slip or caption error), so they move on a scale far beyond a human life.
cells_derived_method: At roughly 7 years per sign for Uranus, 14 for Neptune and 20 for Pluto, they stay one sign for long periods and act as generational influences, felt personally mainly by the house they occupy by birth.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in Capricorn in the 10th (lagna Aries) is a long career-structure influence for a whole generation.
Derived: Uranus in Aries in the 4th (lagna Capricorn) brings disruption to home and base.

ambiguity: Pluto period stated as 264 in captions; true figure is about 248. Neptune stated 164 matches reality.
classical_check: Classical Jyotish has no outer planets; his figures for Uranus and Neptune agree with modern astronomy, Pluto differs slightly.

hindi: इसलिए मैंने आज तक कभी कुछ नहीं सोचा है सब मुन्ना सोच रहा है मुन्ना क्या सोच रहा है जब मैं यह ध्यान दूंगा तो मुन्ना तमीज में सोचेगा
says: His personal practice: he does not do the thinking himself; the subconscious does it, and when he gives it attention and a clear direction it thinks in a disciplined way.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: Self-description rather than a rule.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Remark that Saturn is being mischievous, then a joke about a father arriving and an electron quickly turning into a positron.
Story begins: a vendor sells a ghost in a bottle to a rich merchant for 500 rupees; the ghost does any work but eats the owner if given none.
Merchant releases the ghost, which finishes every task in minutes: warehouse, goods, factory; he becomes a billionaire in two days but cannot sleep.
Merchant runs away, the ghost follows doing tree planting and pond digging, finally he reaches a saint's hut.

hindi: अबकी बार इसको कहियो एक बांस लगा तू धरती से आकाश तक और उस पर चढ़ता उतरता रह जब काम होगा मैं बुला लूंगा इसको बिजी रख
says: The saint's solution in the story: keep the restless mind permanently busy with one endless simple task, climbing up and down a bamboo pole, and call it only when real work is needed.
cells_derived_method: Mind-control is Moon territory (manas), so the practice matters most where the Moon is afflicted or placed in an active house; this mapping is derived, not said by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in own sign in the 12th (lagna Leo) gives an imaginative, restless night mind that benefits from a fixed occupying task.
Derived: Moon exalted in the 6th (lagna Sagittarius) gives a strong mind that worries over service and rivals, so a steady busy-task practice steadies it.

ambiguity: He does not name a planet; Moon is inferred from 'mind'.
classical_check: Silent; the idea matches the yogic teaching of keeping the mind engaged on one object.

hindi: बेटा ये मन है ये सारे काम कर सकता है ये इतना चंचल है अगर तूने इसे खाली बिठा दिया तेरा दिमाग खा जाएगा
says: The ghost is the mind: it can do any work and is very restless; if left idle it consumes you, so it must always be given an assignment.
cells_derived_method: Restlessness of the mind is a Moon (and Mercury) matter; derived: a Moon in a movable sign or in the 3rd, 6th or 12th house would feel this more, not said by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in the 3rd in own sign (lagna Taurus) gives a very active, effort-driven mind that needs constant tasks.
Derived: Moon in Aries in the 8th (lagna Virgo) gives an agitated, probing mind prone to turning inward when idle.

ambiguity: Planet not named; mind=Moon is inferred.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: classical texts make the Moon the significator of mind (Chandra manaso jatah).

hindi: ये सांस है जब तेरे को परेशानी हो ना इसको बोल सासों के साथ साथ रह यह कमांड है मुन्ना को ये कमांड दे दो तो सांस के साथ रह जब जरूरत होगी बुला लूंगा
says: The bamboo pole stands for the breath: when troubled, tell the mind 'stay with the breath', and it will stay busy until you call it for real work; this is the correct way to give the mind a command.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: Command words are partly garbled ('साथ र'); sense is clearly 'stay with the breath'.
classical_check: Silent in Jyotish; matches pranayama and breath-watching practice.

gist: Joke about writing 'O woman come tomorrow' on the door and the woman coming tomorrow, not applying to women of the house.
Says the audience question was how to give commands correctly; then takes the next question about vastu and sleeping on an iron bed.

hindi: क्या घर में सोने के लिए टायरन का बेड इस्तेमाल कर सकते हैं क्यों नहीं कर सकते बिल्कुल कर सकते हैं पर इसकी डायरेक्शन जो होगी वो आपकी वेस्ट साइड पर होगी
says: An iron bed is allowed for sleeping at home, but it should be placed on the west side of the room or house, since iron is Saturn's metal and west is Saturn's direction.
cells_derived_method: Saturn's direction (west) is the classical link; derived: for a native whose Saturn is a strong benefic lord (for example Capricorn or Aquarius lagna) the placement is most supportive, not said by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn lagna lord in the 1st in Capricorn is own-sign, so an iron bed in the west suits the native.
Derived: Saturn exalted in the 8th (lagna Pisces) is a hidden-strength placement, so keeping iron in its own west direction avoids stirring it wrongly.

ambiguity: 'टायरन' is the caption for 'iron'; 'वेस्ट साइड' could mean west side of the room or of the house, not specified.
classical_check: Consistent with the Vastu/Jyotish assignment of iron and west to Saturn; classical texts are otherwise silent on beds.

gist: Audience question: wishing comes before any action, yet he says to act without wishing; he agrees wishing comes first.

hindi: मेरे को कैट का एग्जाम पास करा दे बिना इच्छा के करो वो पूरी कैट लगा देगा आपके पीछे हमारा जो देवता होता है ना वास्तु मंडल का ब्रह्मा सेंटर
says: If you wish for a specific outcome like passing the CAT exam, do it as a plain instruction without desperate wanting, and the subconscious will pour its whole effort behind you; he then begins to introduce the deity of the vastu mandala, Brahma at the centre.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: Passage ends mid-sentence about the vastu mandala centre, so the vastu claim itself is not yet stated; the CAT exam link rests on a noisy caption.
classical_check: Vastu Purusha Mandala puts Brahma at the centre (Brahmasthan), which agrees; the wish teaching is silent classically.

hindi: सबसे पहले चार देवता बनते हैं ब्रह्मा तो स्टार्टिंग है बेस है ... भूधर बनता है भूधर के बाद आर्यमा बनता है उसके बाद विवस्वान फिर मित्र ये चार बनते हैं देवता
says: After Brahma (the centre, the starting base), the first four deities of the vastu grid appear: Bhudhar (holder of the earth), then Aryama, Vivasvan and Mitra. He presents them as the four that arise first around the land.
cells_derived_method: none. This is a vastu-deity list, not a house or sign rule. If the four are later tied to directions, the link to houses would come from direction-to-house mapping, not from this sentence.
ambiguity: He says these four have 'north, south, west'; in the classical vastu purusha mandala the four around Brahma are Aryama (east), Vivasvan (south), Mitra (west), Bhudhar (north). Caption may have dropped east. Order of mention is not a direction mapping.
classical_check: Agrees on the four names around Brahma in the vastu mandala (Aryama, Vivasvan, Mitra, Prithvidhara/Bhudhar); direction detail is garbled here.

hindi: ये चारों के चारों देवता हमारे लाइफ के अंदर कारण इच्छा करना करने के संसाधन ... और करने के बाद उसके द्वारा उसकी प्राप्ति क्या होगी यह चारों डिसाइड करते हैं
says: He assigns the four deities a life function chain: they decide the cause or desire to act, the means and resources to act, the money for it, and finally what is attained as the result. All four must be present for Brahma (the creative base) to have a reason to act.
cells_derived_method: none. A four-stage chain (desire, resources, wealth, attainment) with no house or sign given. A later derivation could compare it to the 1-5-9 intent, 2-6-10 effort and 11 gain groupings, but he does not say so.
ambiguity: Which deity does which stage is not stated in the caption; only that the four together decide all of them.
classical_check: Silent. Vastu texts give each deity a direction and domain, not this four-stage desire-to-attainment chain.

gist: Says wanting to act and having a desire is ordinary, true for nearly everyone; only a tiny fraction goes beyond it.
Says when human consciousness reaches a certain level you will get a home where only grace rains; no specific rule or method given.
Spiritual advice: stay in witness mode all 24 hours instead of one hour of hard meditation, so practice is not trapped in a ritual.
Aside that he does not run meditation camps and does not know how to teach breathing technique; he only passes on what he has understood.
Says life is a play of words and the ultimate aim is to become one with the divine; Ek Onkar, nirbhau, nirvair quoted.

hindi: कर यह हमारे कर बोलते हैं हाथों को कर शब्द है ये कर हाथों से करने वाला ... हृदय में कौन है शुक्र और वरुण ये दो देवता है
says: He plays on the word 'kar' (hand, and also 'doer') in Ek Onkar and says the hands are the instrument of doing, which comes from the heart. The heart is held by two deities, Venus (Shukra) and Varuna, which in his twelve-planet scheme is Neptune.
cells_derived_method: none. A body-centre karaka (heart centre = Venus and Varuna) with no house or sign given. Derived idea only: Venus and Neptune placed in or ruling the 4th house or the Cancer-Leo region would colour the heart-centre expression, but he does not say this.
ambiguity: 'Varuna' is taken as Neptune from his twelve-planet scheme; he does not say Neptune in this sentence. The Ek Onkar etymology (kar = hands) is wordplay, not a Sanskrit derivation.
classical_check: Differs. Classical Jyotish gives the heart to the Sun and the 4th house, and Venus to the 7th-house region and urogenital area; Venus-Neptune on the heart is his own scheme.

hindi: पंछी के क्या होते हैं फरर फरर फरर पंख हमारे हाथ हम ताली पीटते हैं ... वाह वाह ये डाउन गए हमारी कॉन्शसनेस ये ऊपर गई
says: He compares hands to a bird's wings: when we clap and say wah-wah, the hands going down and the consciousness going up together are the body expressing joy. So the hands act as the heart centre's wings and the visible gesture of raised consciousness.
cells_derived_method: none. An illustration of the heart-centre idea in the previous sentence, not a house or sign dependent rule.
ambiguity: The caption is cut at a timestamp boundary; the clapping image is an analogy, with no astrological placement stated.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यह कॉन्शसनेस का मजा आ गया बस यह हमारी कॉन्शसनेस का बॉडी का एक्सप्रेशन है यह कार सेवा है
says: He concludes that clapping and applauding is the body's expression of consciousness rising, and that this is the real meaning of 'kar seva' (service by the hands), tying hand action to the Venus and Varuna heart centre.
cells_derived_method: none. Not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: Whether the heart-centre planets are meant here again is inferred from the previous lines, not stated in this sentence.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Contrasts Omkar (the witness doing the work) with ahankar (ego saying I did it, my child, my house); says Omkar runs the whole creation so will run yours too.
Scolds audience for not trusting God who is already breathing inside them; says the one flaw of life is lack of trust.
Describes how people keep wanting something better: car, bank balance, girlfriend, wife, bigger house, never realising they already have enough.
Says one should realise good has already happened once or twice and learn to be happy instead of chasing better until death.
Story of women who demanded a handsome rich husband, got him, then complain of no love and company; he says the demand itself was wrong and no remedy changes it.
Says people then blame pandits and astrologers as thieves and God as deaf, when the wish was already granted; the one who asks nothing gets the best.

hindi: कब किसी व्यक्ति को अपने बच्चे की कुंडली दिखाने के लिए ज्योतिषी के पास जाना चाहिए जब उसके बच्चे की लाइफ में प्रॉब्लम हो हर हालत में उसको जाना चाहिए लेकिन हस्बैंड वाइफ की कुंडली लेकर
says: Answering an audience question, he says a parent should consult an astrologer about a child's chart when the child's life has a problem, and must go bringing the husband's and wife's own charts, not only the child's, because the cause lies in the parents' charts.
cells_derived_method: none. A procedural rule about which charts to read, not house or sign specific. Derived link: the child's trouble would be checked in the parents' 5th house and 5th lord, but he does not say it here.
ambiguity: Whether he means only when a problem exists, or says to go always ('हर हालत में'), is slightly unclear; reads as: go in any case where a problem exists.
classical_check: Partly differs. Classical practice reads the child's own chart for the child's matters and the parents' 5th house for progeny; asking for both parents' charts is common in practice but he gives no rule.

hindi: अगर प्रॉब्लम आ गई है इसका मतलब माता-पिता के भाग में दुख लिखा है बच्चे से सुख नहीं लिखा 100% पक्का है कोई ना कोई पितृ दोष है
says: He claims that if a child has a problem, then the parents' destiny carries sorrow from the child and no happiness from the child, and that it is 100 percent certain some pitru dosha (ancestral affliction) exists. Stated as a certainty; this is a tradition claim and the absolute certainty is not supported by classical texts.
cells_derived_method: none. Not tied to a house or sign by him. Derived: a pitru dosha reading would normally look at the 9th house and its lord, the Sun, and afflictions by Rahu or Saturn, but he does not say this.
ambiguity: 'Pitru dosha' is not defined here; no planets or houses named. Absolute certainty is his wording.
classical_check: Differs in strength. Classical texts link progeny trouble to the 5th house, Jupiter and putra-karaka afflictions, and treat pitru dosha as one possible cause; a 100 percent claim is not classical.

hindi: वो मोटे मोटे उपाय बताएगा ... जिसमें मोटा खर्चा करेगा वो खर्चा क्या कराएगा आपका धन पर डालेगा स्यापा सारा तो आपको तन या मन का सुख मिलेगा
says: He says the astrologer will prescribe large remedies for pitru dosha that cost heavy money, and the loss of wealth is the price that lets the parents receive peace of body or mind; the cost is borne on the money side. Records that he says remedies carry a heavy financial cost; not financial advice.
cells_derived_method: none. A general remedy economics claim, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: The caption at the timestamp boundary runs into the next chunk; 'spend on wealth, receive body or mind comfort' is a sound reading but the syntax is rough.
classical_check: Silent. Classical texts prescribe daan, mantra and puja for pitru dosha but do not state that heavy payment is required.

hindi: अगर चमत्कारिक रूप से जीवन बदलना है तो अल्ट के अंदर आपको पैसा फूकना पड़ेगा हम पैसा फूकना नहीं चाहते
says: He states a principle that a miraculous change in life requires spending real money: to change a fate through remedy you must burn money, and people refuse to. He is justifying why remedies cost a lot. Tradition claim, not a financial recommendation.
cells_derived_method: none. Not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'अल्ट' is garbled in the caption, probably 'alternate' or 'ultimately'; the meaning of the sentence does not depend on it.
classical_check: Differs. Classical sources value daan by capacity and sincerity, not a fixed heavy payment; this is his claim.

gist: Hospital analogy: nobody expects a doctor in a big Delhi hospital to operate free with a blessing, people pay lakhs and plead, yet call the pandit a thief for charging.
Says a successful astrologer or vastu consultant charges 11,000, 21,000 up to lakhs, rich clients become richer, and he deserves such fees because he makes them wealthy; caption cuts off.
Rich people can spend 10-20 lakh on a hospital operation without worry, a poor family borrows from relatives to pay for ICU care; he says spending money is how one recovers.

hindi: इसलिए बच्चे की कुंडली 15 साल से दिखानी चाहिए
says: He advises that a child's horoscope should be consulted from about age 15, not left until later, so problems can be caught and remedied in time.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: Whether 15 means completed 15 years or the 15th year is not clear; it is a practical advice rather than a calculable rule.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts give no age-15 consultation rule, though they do describe dasha-based stages of childhood.

hindi: 15 साल के बाद बृहस्पति का एक ऐसा परिवर्तन होता है कि फर्स्ट आने वाला बच्चा शायद फेल हो जाता है बृहस्पति में खास दोष होते हैं वक्री होता है
says: After about age 15 Jupiter's influence changes, and if Jupiter carries a flaw such as retrograde motion, a child who used to rank first may start failing in studies. Retrograde is promised in a later lecture.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter rules knowledge, so a flawed Jupiter hurts studies; the area hit depends on its house. In the 5th it touches intellect, in the 4th school, in the 9th higher learning; sign strength (Cancer strong, Capricorn weak) changes the severity.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter debilitated in the 5th (lagna Virgo) would be the stronger version of a flawed Jupiter, with intellect and exam performance suffering.
Derived: Jupiter exalted in the 4th (lagna Aries) is not flawed by sign, so only retrograde would be the concern; school stage is the affected area.
Derived: Jupiter in Gemini in the 9th (lagna Libra) is in an enemy sign, so higher education and teachers are the weak area.

ambiguity: The mechanism behind the change at 15 is not explained; it may mean a dasha shift or a general transit claim. Other flaws besides retrograde are not listed.
classical_check: Classical texts give Jupiter as karaka of learning, but the age-15 shift is not classical; silent.

hindi: शुक्र का दोष हो गया बायोलॉजी गई बुध का दोष हो गया मैथ्स गया यह लिख कर दिए जाएंगे
says: A flaw in Venus ruins the child's chances in biology, a flaw in Mercury ruins mathematics; he says this is fixed and will be written down, not found in any book.
cells_derived_method: Subject fate depends on the flawed planet's house and sign. Mercury in the 5th or 4th hits maths more directly than Mercury in the 12th; Venus in the 6th (disease house) or 8th changes biology differently than Venus in the 2nd.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury debilitated in Pisces in the 4th (lagna Sagittarius) is a strongly flawed Mercury sitting in the school house, so maths trouble.
Derived: Venus debilitated in Virgo in the 6th (lagna Aries) is flawed and in the disease house, so biology or medicine study is blocked.
Derived: Venus exalted in Pisces in the 10th (lagna Gemini) is not flawed by sign, so no such block is read from sign alone.

ambiguity: He does not define what counts as a flaw for Venus and Mercury.
classical_check: Mercury as karaka of maths and Venus of arts is classical, but Venus for biology is his own assignment; classical texts do not say this.

hindi: मंगल का दोष आ गया डॉक्टर बन के दिखाओ बन ही नहीं सकते भले ही बच्चा एमबीबीएस में एडमिशन ले रहा है
says: With a flaw in Mars, the person cannot become a doctor even if he gets admission to MBBS; he claims this as certain and says the admission will not carry through.
cells_derived_method: Mars is the surgery and blood karaka, so a flawed Mars blocks medical practice. House changes it: in the 6th it affects service and treatment, in the 10th the profession itself, in the 8th operations and sudden turns.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 10th (lagna Libra) is a flawed Mars in the career house, so medical profession is blocked.
Derived: Mars debilitated in the 6th (lagna Aquarius) is flawed, but 6th is an upachaya house where Mars usually helps; mixed result.
Derived: Mars in own sign Aries in the 3rd (lagna Aquarius) is strong, not flawed, so no block is read.

ambiguity: He does not state what makes Mars flawed. The claim is absolute, so treat it as a tradition claim and not as a predictable outcome.
classical_check: Classical texts connect Mars and Sun with medicine and surgery but never say a flawed Mars makes MBBS impossible; this is his own strong claim.

hindi: हर हालत के अंदर ज्यादा जरूरी है आपके लिए कि आप 15 साल के बाद बच्चे की पतरी जरूर दिखाए और पैसे फूके
says: He repeats that parents must show the child's chart after 15 and must be prepared to spend money on remedies; he frames the spending as the precaution that saves the child's career.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: Amount and kind of spending are not specified here; it also serves as a business pitch for consultations.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Vaccination analogy: parents gave polio drops and injections, the grown child says it would not have happened anyway, so astrology precautions also look unneeded when they work.

hindi: लाख दो लाख का पत्थर पहन ले ... जब तुम कमाते हो 100 साल चलता है पत्थर
says: He defends gemstones as a one-time cost that lasts a hundred years, compared with a phone that is obsolete in two years, and says people who call astrologers cheats are wrong. This records his claim only and is not advice to buy a stone.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: No planet or stone is named in this sentence, so the specific remedy cannot be read.
classical_check: Gemstone remedies are post-classical; Parashara and Varahamihira describe gems as gifts or ornaments, not as graha remedies.

hindi: पैसे तो फूकने पड़ेंगे धन की बली दोगे ठीक कैसे होगा तन मन धन समझ लो
says: He says every remedy needs sacrifice of money (dhan ki bali), and a cure works only when body, mind and wealth are all given; the money may go in the name of God, vastu or an astrologer.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: The 'eight parts' he mentions at the end is a garbled count and is not clear.
classical_check: Dana as a remedy is classical, but the claim that nothing works without payment to a professional is his own and not in texts.

gist: Teacher moves on to the next audience question, which is about Lal Kitab.

hindi: लाल किताब की रेमेडीज काम करती है 100%
says: Answering an audience question, he says Lal Kitab remedies work 100 percent, but he admits he does not know Lal Kitab and gets such remedies done through others.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: The 100 percent claim comes without any evidence and he also says he has not studied the book.
classical_check: Lal Kitab is a 20th-century text outside the Parashari tradition; classical texts are silent on it.

hindi: जिस घर की प्रॉब्लम हो रही है चौथे घर के अंदर जल का स्थान होता है पानी में भा दो उस ग्रह की चीज
says: For a problem in a house, the 4th house stands for the place of water in the home, so the remedy is to float the item of the troubling planet in water. The sentence is partly garbled.
cells_derived_method: 4th house means home, water and mother. The planet whose item is floated depends on who is troubling: Saturn's item for a Saturn problem, Moon for mind. House of the problem decides which planet is meant.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 4th house in its natural sign Cancer (lagna Aries) makes the water link strongest, so water-based remedy is most apt here.
Derived: 4th house in Capricorn (lagna Libra) is an earth sign, so the water remedy is a weaker fit and the item may need to be buried instead.

ambiguity: Garbled caption; it is unclear whether the 4th house is the problem house or just the remedy location in the home, and which item of which planet is floated.
classical_check: Floating items in water is a Lal Kitab idea; Parashari texts are silent.

gist: Joking about ego (ghamand), his not having written a book, and a mock class named 'hu hu ghamand'.

hindi: ये हमारा लगन है यह हमारा पांचवा घर
says: He begins drawing a chart on the board and names the lagna and the 5th house, setting up the trine (trikona) lesson that follows.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: Only labels the board; the content is in the next chunk.
classical_check: Agrees with classical house naming.

hindi: यह लगन है यह पांचवा घर है यह नौवा घर है ... ये मूल त्रिकोण है
says: The 1st, 5th and 9th houses, each five houses from the previous, form the mool trikona (root trine) of the chart.
cells_derived_method: The trine houses carry the same topic cluster in every lagna, but the sign on each shifts. The three houses always sit in one element (fire, earth, air or water).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for lagna Aries the trine is Aries-Leo-Sagittarius, all fire signs, so the root trine is a fire group.
Derived: for lagna Taurus the trine is Virgo-Capricorn-Taurus, all earth signs.
Derived: for lagna Libra the trine is Gemini-Libra-Aquarius, all air signs.

ambiguity: Mool trikona is normally a planet's sign-segment term, so using it for the trine houses is his own wording.
classical_check: Agrees that 1, 5, 9 are trikona; the word mool trikona normally means something else.

hindi: अगर आपकी कुंडली में यह घर बलवान है यह घर बलवान है और यह घर बलवान है तो आपके पास ज्ञान चल के आएगा पढ़ने की जरूरत नहीं है
says: If the 1st, 5th and 9th houses are all strong, knowledge comes to you on its own without needing to study; he gives himself as an example of having no single guru.
cells_derived_method: Strength depends on the sign on each house and its lord. Houses whose sign is owned by a strong lord in a good place give wisdom; a trine with weak lords reduces it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 9th house in Sagittarius (lagna Aries) with Jupiter strong makes the 9th the strongest, supporting teachers and self-learning.
Derived: 5th house in Scorpio (lagna Cancer) is a research-leaning sign, so knowledge comes through inquiry rather than ease.
Derived: lagna in Capricorn depends on Saturn, so strength of the 1st is judged by Saturn's placement.

ambiguity: Strong is not defined, whether by lord, aspect or shadbala.
classical_check: Trines as the houses of fortune and wisdom agrees with Parashara; the claim that learning is unnecessary is his own.

gist: Says he has no single guru, learned from everyone, and compares adding his own flavour to borrowed knowledge to adding chaat masala to a potato tikki.
Teacher talks to someone in the class who would not move and then agreed, and says he himself is the lagna on the board.

hindi: यह है मेरा एक घुटना ये है मेरा दूसरा घुटना ... ये मेरी छाती है यह मेरा लोअर पार्ट है यह मेरे पैर है यह मेरी दोनों अलग अलग आंखें है
says: Using a rough body mapping, he treats the chart like a body: knees, chest, lower part, feet and two eyes are matched to chart points. This is a teaching aid and the precise assignment is not clear from the caption.
cells_derived_method: Classical kalapurusha assigns Aries head, Taurus face, Gemini arms, down to Pisces feet; houses carry the same body parts counted from lagna. His mapping is rough and cannot be pinned to cells.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries would map to the head in kalapurusha, so lagna is the head.
Derived: the 12th house in Pisces maps to the feet, and the left eye is also a 12th-house topic.

ambiguity: Garbled; unclear which house is a knee, which the chest, which the eyes. He himself says to take it roughly.
classical_check: The house-body mapping matches the classical kalapurusha idea, but his board mapping is not given enough to compare.

hindi: इससे पांचवा इससे नवा ... एक दूसरे से नव पांच है नव पंच कहते हैं इसे
says: Houses that stand 5th and 9th from each other form the nav-pancham relation; he shows that the 1st, 5th and 9th counted from any of them link in the same way.
cells_derived_method: Nav-pancham links any house with the houses five and nine from it, so each house sits in a trine group. For example the 2nd links to the 6th and 10th, the 3rd to the 7th and 11th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: with 2nd house Taurus (lagna Aries), the nav-pancham group is the 2nd, 6th and 10th, which are Taurus, Libra and Capricorn.
Derived: with the 4th house in Cancer (lagna Aries), the group is the 4th, 8th and 12th, the water trine of moksha houses.

ambiguity: Nava-pancham in classical astrology is normally the 5-9 relation between planets, so he is applying it to houses.
classical_check: Agrees that 5 and 9 from a point form a trine; the use for houses relative to each other is common in house-from-house reading.

hindi: यह पांचवा घर किसका होता है संतान इससे पांचवा इसकी संतान ... मैं किसी की संतान एक मेरी संतान
says: The 5th house stands for children; the 5th from the 5th (the 9th house) is the child's child, while he himself is the child of someone else, so each house is read as one link in a family chain.
cells_derived_method: House-from-house method: for any relative, count from the house that stands for that person. The chain works the same in all lagnas, but the sign on each house changes the nature of the relative.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 5th house in Leo (lagna Aries) shows a proud, strong child; the grandchild house is the 9th, Sagittarius.
Derived: 5th house in Pisces (lagna Scorpio) shows a gentle spiritual child; the grandchild house is the 9th, Scorpio, with an intense nature.

ambiguity: Mixes who is 'I' and who is 'child' in a spoken drawing; the chain is clear but the order of statements is jumbled.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical bhavat bhavam method; the 5th from the 5th as grandchild is a standard use.

hindi: यह पांचवे से पांचवा है तो संतान की संतान यह मेरा पोता भी है अगर मैं अपने पिता से सुख नहीं ले सका ऐसा दोष हो तो पोते से भी नहीं ले सकता
says: The 9th house is the father and, being the 5th from the 5th, also the grandson. So a flaw that denies happiness from the father will also deny it from the grandson. The remedies, he says, are possible but he will not go into them now.
cells_derived_method: Check the 9th house affliction and treat the 9th as father and also grandson. Afflicted by Saturn or Rahu in an enemy sign, both relations suffer. A strong 9th sign supports both.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: the 9th in Gemini (lagna Libra) with Rahu there would be read as friction with the father and the grandson.
Derived: the 9th in Leo (lagna Sagittarius) is the Sun's sign, so the father link is strong unless the Sun is afflicted.

ambiguity: Here the 9th acts as grandson from the 5th-from-5th reading, which he says about himself and not as a generic rule.
classical_check: Father from the 9th agrees with Parashara; grandson from the 5th-from-5th agrees with bhavat bhavam, but linking both to the same affliction is his own inference.

hindi: नौवे से पुनः नौवा कौन है यह इसका पिता यह मेरा दादा भी है अगर मेरे दादा से मुझे सुख नहीं मिला मुझे मेरी संतान से भी नहीं मिलेगा
says: The 9th from the 9th (the 5th house of the chart, counting round the trine) is the grandfather; if there is no happiness from the grandfather, there will be none from one's own child either, since the same house group carries both.
cells_derived_method: Count 9th from the 9th to get the house of the grandfather. In the 12 lagnas the house stays the 5th from lagna, so the child and grandfather share the 5th house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: the 5th house in Aries (lagna Sagittarius) with Mars in a weak spot would bring difficulty from both grandfather and children.
Derived: the 5th house in Taurus (lagna Capricorn) has Venus as lord, and a well-placed Venus eases both links.

ambiguity: The 9th from the 9th is the 5th house of the chart, so he is linking grandfather and child in the same house; he does not say this directly, but it follows from his count.
classical_check: The 9th from the 9th as grandfather agrees with bhavat bhavam; the claim of shared fate with children is his own.

gist: Ends the chunk by saying he is the child of his father and the father of his child, setting up how to fix the situation.

hindi: मैं पितरों की कृपा लो ये है मेरे पितर और यह है मेरा धर्म ... पिता का आशीर्वाद लू धर्म स्थान मंदिर मस्जिद चर्च कोई भी
says: The cure for a weak 9th and 5th is to win the blessing of ancestors, father and the place of dharma (any temple, mosque or church), by donating there and attending.
cells_derived_method: 9th is father and dharma, 5th is children. Remedy is the same in every lagna; what changes is which relative is the source of the problem, driven by the sign and lord on the 9th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: the 9th in Scorpio (lagna Pisces) shows trouble from the father's side that is hidden, so ancestors' blessing is the main remedy.
Derived: the 9th in Pisces (lagna Cancer) is Jupiter's sign; the dharma-place and teacher side of the remedy fits best.

ambiguity: Garbled; 'my dharma' may mean the 9th house as dharma or the 5th, and the two are mixed in speech.
classical_check: Pitru dosha remedies agree with later tradition; Parashara describes dana and rites for ancestors under the 9th lord in affliction.

hindi: पिता की समाधि पर जाते हैं ... पितृ पक्ष में पूजा करते हैं तो यह तीनों ओके कर दोगे ना कृपा मिलनी शुरू हो जाएगी
